why: Searches found active related literature (Looper-Yap on torsion points of abelian varieties over function fields, work on Mazur's Conjecture B, Bremner's conjecture notes, elliptic curve height bounds) but nothing that proves, disproves, or narrows the stated conjecture itself (uniform N(K,g) for genus g≥2 curves over a number field K). The conjecture remains open per its Wikipedia article and cited sources.
